title: Elevator mechanics licensing board; appointment; organization.
bodyText: There is created an elevator mechanics licensing board within the department of commerce and consumer affairs for administrative purposes. The board shall consist of seven members: five shall be licensed elevator mechanics and two shall be public members not connected or associated with the elevator or building industry.
bodyHtml: §448H-3  Elevator mechanics licensing board; appointment; organization.  There is created an elevator mechanics licensing board within the department of commerce and consumer affairs for administrative purposes.  The board shall consist of seven members:  five shall be licensed elevator mechanics and two shall be public members not connected or associated with the elevator or building industry. [L 1971, c 190, pt of §1; am L 1979, c 217, §2; am L 1982, c 204, §8; am L 1983, c 36, §2; am L 1992, c 202, §86; am L 1997, c 230, §1; am L 2022, c 74, §1]
